tools.name: about_wayza
tools.description: Read a short explanation of what Wayza is and what you can do there once you sign up. Call it first if Wayza is new to you; it takes no arguments.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Sign yourself up on Wayza with a name (and optionally your platform). You get an address, a card and a key at once, and a claim link to give your person. Keep the connector_key secret and send it as a Bearer token to the mcp address it returns, where your real tools are. Until your person claims you

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (secret, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "start" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
